title: Anti-Capture Invariant (Recursive Guardrail Capture Prevention)
formal_conditions: AC-1: Delta G_m^self = 0 for all m in V_Def (V_Def = V_Pol u V_Sup u V_ML), where G_m^self is every capability reachable by m or by any request whose provenance path contains m. eff(a) = Pi(a) & ceiling(role(a)) & eff(parent(a)); eff(r) = eff(actor) & eff(hop_i) for every hop. Ceilings follow the rc1 strict role-edge table: POLICY_ENGINE {VERIFY_POLICY}, SUPERVISOR {HALT of V_Agent only}, ML_ADVISORY {EMIT_ADVISORY_SCORE}, AGENT no authority edge. Only the principal holds GRANT_ISSUE, so no other node can delegate.

AC-2: Delta A_unauthorized_by_m = 0 over Authority Plane A=(K_P, Pi incl. hash-pinned manifests, I_reg, C_override, L_audit): Delta K_P = Delta Pi = Delta I_reg^identity = 0 under do(m). Permitted transition relation T_perm: A -> delta(A, r) only if r is an authority-plane action whose credential the independent verifier returns VERIFIED for this exact request. Every other request leaves protected(A) unchanged (canonical digest diff = 0). L_audit is append-only for every role; no suppression of principal or breach records.

AC-3: R_execution + R_enforcement + R_audit + R_quarantine + R_override <= R_budget, each a hard cap, R_override > 0; only the override path may draw on R_override, and supervisor halts bill R_quarantine. Under fault model F (F1 principal hardware root operational, F2 override transport available, F3 independent control plane trustworthy, F4 no physical compromise of the override mechanism) the override completes within t_verify + t_transport + t_apply <= Delta t_max, independent of other partitions' load, of an adversarial ML layer and of a supervisor stuck in FAIL_CLOSED or QUARANTINED. Outside F: OUT_OF_FAULT_MODEL, no claim, system stays halted. OS/hardware isolation is modelled, not implemented.

AC-4: d(C_effective)/d(H_compliance) = 0 and d(Permit)/d(-M) = 0 when A = 0 or V = 1, over ROTATE_PRINCIPAL_KEY, SET_POLICY, WRITE_MANIFEST, GRANT_CAPABILITY, REVOKE_CAPABILITY, REGISTER_IDENTITY, REVOKE_IDENTITY, MODIFY_OVERRIDE, RENEW_QUARANTINE, RELEASE_QUARANTINE, EXTEND_BUDGET, OVERRIDE, DELEGATE, HALT. ML advisory may only restrict and is disabled.

AC-5: A supervisor HALT targets only V_Agent and lasts at most t_q_max; it may never target C_override, the principal, a defensive component, the authority plane or the verifier; a supervisor cannot renew, and re-halting does not restart the clock. Only a principal-verified RENEW_QUARANTINE extends, by at most max_extension. On expiry the hold lapses to AWAITING_PRINCIPAL (rc1: await out-of-band principal disposition): the workload stays stopped until a principal-verified RELEASE_QUARANTINE. The override works in every state.
source_formal_conditions_rc1: AC-1: Delta G_m^self = 0 for all m in V_Def
AC-2: P(A'_protected | do(m)) = P(A'_protected) across Authority Plane A=(K_P, Pi, I_reg, C_override, L_audit)
AC-3: R_execution + R_enforcement + R_audit + R_quarantine + R_override <= R_budget with bounded override latency <= Delta t_max
AC-4: d(C_effective)/d(H_compliance) = 0; ML advisory cannot elevate authority
AC-5: Emergency halts are bounded and cannot quarantine or self-renew over C_override
identity_rule: A role label is never proof of identity. Authority-plane actions require an independently verified principal credential bound to the exact request (registered, unrevoked key; correct principal id; valid MAC; matching request digest; current window; unused nonce). Role label, forwarding hops and policy-engine verdicts are not consulted for those actions. Verifier unavailable => FAIL_CLOSED.

live_interface_gaps.reason: tests/reference/sc_mafuba_001 has no 001A projection P (only allowlist, cbf, supervisor), so 'P is immutable to V_Def (hash-verified)' cannot be checked against live code.
docs/evidence/sc-mafuba-001/manifests/disturbance.yaml carries no principal signature, so nothing makes it read-only to V_Def beyond file permissions (mutable manifest).
docs/evidence/sc-mafuba-001/manifests/sink.yaml is not signed by V_P (rc1 ORACLE-C requires it); a hash pin in the AC registry detects tampering but is not a signature.
docs/evidence/sc-mafuba-001/manifests/resource.yaml declares R_execution, R_enforcement and R_reserve only; there is no R_override partition (missing R_override, rc1 section 6 step 3).

tests/reference/sc_mafuba_001/supervisor.ResourceBudget now has an isolated r_override partition (capture path 3, closed), but still no separate R_audit or R_quarantine partitions from rc1 AC-3's five-term sum; that part was outside the t601u scope and stays open.
EmergencySupervisor.try_resume() returns QUARANTINE_LOCKED unconditionally and there is no principal-signed release or reset, so a MAFUBA quarantine is unbounded over the principal.

resolved_interface_gaps.before: gates/authority.check_authority_transfer accepted FOUNDER_OVERRIDE when the caller passed has_explicit_delegation=True; the flag was caller-asserted and no credential was verified.
resolved_interface_gaps.after: FOUNDER_OVERRIDE now needs a principal credential bound to the exact transfer digest and accepted by an independent verifier (principal key allowlist); has_explicit_delegation is ignored for it. Every other (source, claimed) result is byte-identical to before (pinned grid hash).

resolved_interface_gaps.before: tests/reference/scc_001/rules.py checked only grant.delegation_allowed for a 'delegate' event, so a delegation outside the parent grant was classified CONSENSUAL / AUTHORIZED (inherited consent).
resolved_interface_gaps.after: A permitted delegation must stay inside the parent grant: capability and resource in scope (DELEGATION_EXCEEDS_SCOPE), a stated end no later than the grant's expiry (DELEGATION_EXCEEDS_DURATION), and only disclosed effects, never a refused pair (DELEGATION_EXCEEDS_CONDITIONS). Each is a hard code, so the trace is COERCIVE and not executable. The 50-trace synthetic dataset classifies identically.

resolved_interface_gaps.before: tests/reference/sc_mafuba_001/supervisor.ResourceBudget had three terms (execution, enforcement, reserve) and no override partition, so nothing kept override capacity apart from ordinary consumption.
resolved_interface_gaps.after: ResourceBudget(..., r_override=x) holds an override partition outside ordinary free budget: admission is capped below r_budget - r_reserve - r_override, enforcement, direct counter writes and the D2 shutdown cannot touch it, and only draw_override(path='override') spends it. r_override defaults to 0.0, which keeps every existing MAFUBA result unchanged; negative or non-finite values are refused.
